cornerstone.notes: Independently verified against the prospectus. full_quote on page 254 ('RESTRICTIONS ON THE CORNERSTONE INVESTORS', printed page 246) matches the candidate verbatim. Page 253 Cornerstone Placing table confirms exactly two cornerstone investors: HK Technology Innovation (HK$299,000,000 / 13,842,500 Offer Shares) and JSC International (for and on behalf of Shenghai SP) (HK$173,002,500 / 7,929,400), total HK$472,002,500 / 21,771,900 - matching the holders field. Listing Date 2026-09-29 confirmed (timetable page 5; dealings commence 9:00 a.m. Tuesday, September 29, 2026). Independent date recomputation: 'six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date' makes 2026-09-29 the first restricted day, so the six-month window runs 2026-09-29 through 2027-03-28; computed_last_restricted_day=2027-03-28 and computed_first_free_day=2027-03-29 (the six-month anniversary) are correct under the inclusive-endpoint convention used repo-wide (e.g. 9971). Sole exception in the quote is transfers to wholly-owned subsidiaries bound by identical obligations, correctly noted.

controller_6m.notes: Agree with exists=false. Independently verified that the Controlling Shareholders gave a SINGLE combined undertaking under Rules 10.07 and 18C.14(1) covering the period ending 'on the date which is 12 months from the Listing Date' (page 275, 'Undertakings by Controlling Shareholders' in Underwriting) - there is no separate six-month disposal undertaking for the Controlling Shareholders, the standard 10.07 6m-disposal/12m-control split being superseded by the Chapter 18C combined undertaking. The 6m slot correctly records the combined undertaking's location (quote_page 275) and the full_quote matches page 275 verbatim. Cross-checked that the separate undertakings on pages 275-276 are not controlling-shareholder undertakings: the Key Persons' 12-month undertaking under Rule 18C.14(1) (pages 275-276) and the Pathfinder SIIs' 6-month undertaking under Rule 18C.14(2) (page 276) - neither creates a separate 6m controller slot, supporting the exists=false treatment. Empty computed dates/reference_date are appropriate for a non-existent block.

RESTRICTION ON TRANSFER') both cite 'Rules 10.07 and 18C.13' for the same undertaking, while page 275 cites 'Rules 10.07 and 18C.14(1)' - the candidate's note accurately flags this.
